description: Intranet-styled mailbox-quota notice asks staff to "confirm" their sign-in passphrase so a team member can move them to bigger storage before mail bounces.
rationale: Uses "passphrase" instead of password and an internal look, but it hands the credential to a person under a same-day deadline; storage upgrades never need it.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
